cd /workspace && timeout 175 python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, hashlib, ipaddress, json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/deps')
import campaign
DOC=ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32')
HEADER=('type,id,revision,published,op,lease,event,probe,target,responder,result,service,attempt,payload')
rng=random.Random(5)
leases=[]
for i in range(2048):
    leases.append({'id':'L%04d'%i,'prefix':str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((int(DOC.network_address)+((i+1)<<72),56))),
                   'start':0,'end':10**12,'subnets':[0],'low_count':31})
job={'version':3,'seed':'mx','leases':leases,'services':[{'id':'s','kind':'tcp'}],
     'queries':[10,20,30,40],'captures':[],'requests':[],'offers':[],
     'request_quotas':[],'offer_quotas':[]}
rows=[]
for k in range(200000):
    lease='L%04d'%rng.randrange(2048)
    iid=rng.randrange(1,32)
    target=int(ipaddress.IPv6Network(lease and str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(DOC.network_address)+(int(lease[1:])<<72))+'/56').network_address))+iid
    rows.append(['icmp','r%d'%k,0,5,'put',lease,1,'0/i%d'%iid,str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(target)),
                 str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(target)),'echo','','',''])
blob=(HEADER+'\r\n'+'\r\n'.join(','.join(r) for r in rows)+'\r\n').encode()
import zstandard as zstd
comp=zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=3).compress(blob)
print('plain MB %.0f comp MB %.1f'%(len(blob)/1e6,len(comp)/1e6), file=sys.stderr)
job['captures']=[{'encoding':'zstd','chunks':[base64.b64encode(comp).decode()]}]
job['requests']=[{'id':'R%d'%i,'at':40,'lease':'L%04d'%i,'target':str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(int(DOC.network_address)+(i<<72)+2)),'service':'s','group':'Q'} for i in range(4096)]
job['request_quotas']=[{'id':'Q','parent':None,'capacity':4096}]
start=time.time()
out=campaign.audit(job)
print('elapsed %.1fs manifest %d rejected %d live %d active %d' % (
    time.time()-start, len(out['manifest']), len(out['rejected']),
    out['snapshots'][0]['ledger']['live'], sum(1 for r in out['active_requests'] if r['active'])))
PY
